notes: 2001 Households and Housing PUMF (95M0020X) is not in data/raw. 2006–2021 hierarchical files are present but mislabeled: census_2006.csv = 2006; census_2006_pumf.csv = 2011 NHS; census_2011_nhs.csv = 2016; census_2016_pumf.csv = duplicate of 2006; census_2021_full.csv = 2021.

2001 household 95M0020X (individuals 95M0016X; families 95M0018X). 2006 hierarchical 95M0029X. 2011 NHS hierarchical 99M0002X. 2016 hierarchical 98M0002X (The Daily: 140705 HH / 343330 persons; Abacus: 140720 HH). 2021 hierarchical 98M0002X.
2001 is already one row per household (HHSORT). 2006–2021 hierarchical files are person rows with HH_ID; collapse to one row per HH_ID. Do not treat person TOTINC_AT as household income.
2001 TENURH: 1 owned; 2 rented or band. 2006–2021 TENUR: 1 owned; 2 rented (2011 rented or band); 8 not available. 2006 codebook: 77520 owned / 37485 rented-or-band / 9353 not available households.

2001 OMPH + GROSRTH on the household file. 2006 GROSRT + OMP exist but code 8888 (not available / confidentiality) suppresses shelter for 57.4% of households and almost all 3+ person households; 1-person households retain 95.4%. 2011 GROSRT + OMP nearly complete (98.4% of HH). 2016 and 2021 SHELCO replaces GROSRT/OMP (Borealis 2016 note). Missing codes: 8888 not available; 9999 not applicable. Do not impute suppressed 2006 shelter.

2001 TOTINCH is before-tax total household income for calendar 2000; no TOTINC_AT / TOTINCH_AT on 95M0020X. After-tax income begins with the 2006 PUMF. 2006–2021: sum person TOTINC_AT excluding 8888888/9999999 (2006/2016/2021 7-digit) or 888888/999999 (2011 TOTINC_AT is 6-digit). Children <15 are 9999999 / 999999 not applicable.
2001 TOTINCH. 2006–2021 sum of person TOTINC excluding the same not-available / not-applicable codes.

2001 WEIGHTH = 37 for every household record. 2006 WEIGHT = 100.02061607 for every person (self-weighting). 2011–2021 WEIGHT is the person weight and is constant within household in the 2006 file; 2011+ weights vary across households. Household estimates should use one weight per household, not the sum of person weights.
2001 HHSIZE (1–8+). 2006–2021: count of person rows per HH_ID. Required if MBM is scaled by family size; the current pipeline does not scale MBM.

No MBM variable on 2001 PUMF; MBM is not the 2001 official low-income concept (LICO). 2006–2021 pipeline uses a single-adult national leftover line (2006 $13500; 2011 $15000; 2016 $17000; 2021 $19728) copied from the original script. Official MBM is region- and family-size-specific (StatCan 75F0002M / Table 11-10-0066). 2011 NHS file has EFDIMBM (economic-family MBM flag) which is a different unit and must not be silently substituted for household residual income.

STIR = 12 × monthly shelter / household income. 2001 can be computed only with before-tax TOTINCH (PROXY ONLY relative to the after-tax residual-income design). 2006 all-household STIR is biased by shelter suppression (PROXY ONLY); 2006 one-person STIR is usable. 2011–2021 after-tax STIR is AVAILABLE. 2016/2021 files also carry HCORENEED_IND / STIR_GRP as published complements, not substitutes for the residual-income definition.

Core research quantity. 2001 cannot support after-tax residual income without an undocumented tax imputation — do not manufacture one. 2006 all-household residual income is not comparable because suppressed multi-person households drop out (kept HH mean size 1.46 vs 2.49 in the file). 2006 one-person residual income is AVAILABLE with the single-adult MBM caveat. 2011 is AVAILABLE on the NHS (voluntary) file. 2016 and 2021 are AVAILABLE on mandatory Census hierarchical files with SHELCO.

2001/2006/2016/2021 are Census long-form / 2A-L samples. 2011 is the voluntary National Household Survey (99M0002X). NHS non-response is a documented break; do not treat 2011 as interchangeable with Census waves without stating the break.
